pages.text: The update history of this mod is described.

pages.title: Ver.1.1.3 Page1
pages.text: 1.Fixes & Adjustments $(br) 1-1:Added [Forge:ores] tag to Panakeia bearing Stone. $(br) 1-2:Fixed errors in some recipes for Unite Alloy. $(br) 1-3:Improved compatibility and usability with recipe-viewing mods such as JEI.

pages.title: Ver.1.1.3 Page2
pages.text: 1-4:Fixed a critical bug where, under certain operations, items placed into Alchemy Tables could disappear, or items taken out could duplicate. $(br) 1-5:Increased the durability of runes used for ore doubling by 1.5x across the board.

pages.title: Ver.1.1.2
pages.text: 1.Fixes $(br) 1-1:Fixed misaligned player inventory in the Transcendental Table. $(br) 1-2:Fixed an issue that prevented multiplayer from working properly.

pages.title: Ver.1.1.1
pages.text: 1.Fixes $(br) 1-1:Fixed a bug where the Scarecrow always appeared to face south upon placement and that could despawn. $(br) 1-2:Fixed incorrect drop conditions for Panakeia from Alchetree leaves.

pages.title: Ver.1.1.0 Page1
pages.text: 1.Fixes & Adjustments $(br) 1-1:Fixed an issue where the advanced granulation process of Packed Crushed Iron incorrectly required the Elite Granulating Rune instead of the Elite Grinding Rune. $(br) 1-2:Corrected the durability of Tier 1–3 Panakeia Ingot armor, which was significantly lower than intended.

pages.title: Ver.1.1.0 Page2
pages.text: 1-3:Enhanced the instant-kill effect of the Seven Swords of Terminus. $(br) 1-4:Adjusted some inscription ink recipes to use Black Dye instead of Ink Sacs.

pages.title: Ver.1.1.0 Page3
pages.text: 2.Added Recipes $(br) 2-1:Added new transformation recipes for certain mob drops using the Rune of Equivalent. $(br) 2-2:Added a crafting recipe for Slime Balls.

pages.title: Ver.1.1.0 Page4
pages.text: 3.New Features $(br) 3-1:Introduced the “Alchetree“, a new cultivation method for Panakeia, along with related blocks. $(br) 3-2:Added a Scarecrow craftable from Alchetree. When attacked, it transfers the damage to all nearby living entities.

pages.title: Ver.1.1.0 Page5
pages.text: 4.Added integration with other mods $(br) 4-1:Added Botany Pots support for Panacea Cane and the Alchetree (Botany Trees is not required for the Alchetree). $(br) 4-2:Added integration with Tinkers Construct. various ingots and gems can now be used as tool materials.　$(br) Material traits are based on existing TiC traits for now.

pages.title: Ver.1.1.0 Page6
pages.text: 5.Known Issues $(br) 5-1:Some weapons with special instant-kill effects (e.g., weapons from Re:Avaritia) may cause Scarecrows to die instantly in a way that leaves surrounding mobs in a bugged “undead” state. $(br) 5-2:When Tinkers Construct is not installed, the textures for molten ingot/gem fluids fail to load. $(br) These issues could not be resolved during development. If you know a solution, please reach out!

pages.title: Ver.1.0.1 Page1
pages.text: 1.Fixed Infinite Duplication Glitch $(br) Addressed an issue where crushed Diamond and Emerald ores could be infinitely duplicated using Silk Touch. $(br) 2.Adjusted Item Sorting $(br) Resolved an issue where some items were incorrectly sorted in creative tabs.

pages.title: Ver.1.0.1 Page2
pages.text: 3.Added Item Tags to Some Items $(br) Common item tags have been added to certain items to improve cross-mod compatibility.

pages.title: Ver.1.0.0
pages.text: The initially planned elements are all implemented. $(br)First release.
